name: Review analysis, literature and synthesis claims separately
inputs: A frozen report, dataset and public source access; independent reviewers do not see generator code initially.
transformation: Classify claims by evidence type, independently recompute or retrieve support, then compare against the cited artifact.
outputs: Per-class support rates, discrepant claims and reproducible verification artifacts.
constraints: Small samples do not establish general reliability; ambiguous scientific interpretation needs domain expertise.
validation_proposal: On one already public report, sample 12 claims across three types; two blinded reviewers record support and agreement before opening generator artifacts. No experiment authorized here.

source_locator.title: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery
source_locator.locator: Section 2, Figure 1c–g; paragraphs beginning To assess the overall accuracy and To obtain an orthogonal estimate

evidence: Experts evaluated 102 statements without receiving original supporting code or papers. Overall support was 79.4%; analysis statements 85.5%, literature 82.1%, synthesis 57.9%. Collaborators estimated 6.14 months of equivalent work for 20 cycles (n=7); this was not elapsed human labor measured in a controlled race.
